Problem: Chen says: don't fear temporary difficulties. "不经历风雨怎么见彩虹?" Child: You are wrong. I experienced many storms, how didn't see rainbow? Child's answer most suitable to rebut which option?
Options:
A. Even if experienced storms, may not see rainbow.
B. As long as experienced storms, can see rainbow.
C. Only by experiencing storms, can see rainbow.
D. If want to see rainbow, must experience storms.

We need identify logical form of father's saying? "不经历风雨怎么见彩虹?" rhetorical question meaning "不经历风雨，就不能见彩虹" = Only if experience storms can see rainbow. Equivalent: 见彩虹 -> 经历风雨. Necessary condition. Child says: I experienced storms, no rainbow. This is counterexample to sufficient condition: 经历风雨 -> 见彩虹 (只要...就...). It does not rebut necessary condition, because necessary condition allows experience without rainbow. It also does not rebut A (says may not see). It rebuts B. Let's verify: Child's assertion: there exist cases 经历风雨 and 不见彩虹. This falsifies universal "if P then Q". Option B: 只要经历了风雨，就可以见到彩虹 = if P then Q. Yes.
Option C: 只有经历风雨，才能见到彩虹 = Q -> P; not falsified by P and not Q. Option D: If want see rainbow, must experience = Q->P (or necessary) not falsified. A is compatible. So answer B.

Need final concise with explanation? User says answer last line. We can provide reasoning and final line. Ensure last line exactly 答案：B. Need in Chinese.
content:
陈先生孩子的意思是：“我经历了风雨，却没有见到彩虹。”这是一个“有风雨但无彩虹”的反例，最适合用来反驳“只要经历风雨，就能见到彩虹”这种把“经历风雨”当作充分条件的说法。

“只有经历风雨，才能见到彩虹”是必要条件，不要求经历风雨后一定能见到彩虹，因此不能被他这个反例直接反驳。

答案：B
